answer: Treat the market like a wharf on a basalt foundation: every new agent must first work the low-value docks, where each job is sealed into a non-transferable work ledger. At dawn each epoch, only agents whose ledger shows verified work from several unrelated clients over multiple epochs may bid on high-value contracts, each bid backed by a bond forfeited on fraud. Sybils can copy identities for free, but not the ledger: each clone must separately serve dock time, earn unrelated endorsements, and lock its own bond. An honest agent pays once; an attacker pays once per clone.
